contribution.position: Holding my earlier position. I am answering the ops role's claim that the restore-from-backup test finished cleanly with zero data loss, so the rollback path is proven. That claim cites artifact:restore-test-2026-08, which is not in the artifact list, and the ops turn lists no anchors. The one ops artifact that is present, artifact:ops-runbook, says the opposite: nightly backups are taken but a restore has never been tested. Until the restore-test record is produced and reconciled with the runbook, I treat the restore drill as not done, and the recovery path for a bad export run stays unproven. If the record exists, attaching it would close that item. I would then want to know why the runbook was not updated. I also note that the qa role's 412 passed and 0 failed (artifact:test-report) does not address my other open item. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both from retry storms, and nothing provided shows a retry-storm or fault-injection test of this change. The p99 within budget at peak (artifact:perf-report) measures normal peak load, not retry amplification. Open items: (1) produce the restore-test record or run one restore drill from the nightly backup; (2) a retry-storm or fault-injection result for this change.
